items.title: ZCode – Harness for GLM-5.2
items.author: chvid
items.summary: ZCode is an optimized harness for GLM-5.2, enhancing multi-agent collaboration and coding efficiency. It integrates AI agents with existing tools for seamless planning and deployment. ZCode's free tier offers practical app-building workflows.

items.title: The <Usermedia> HTML Element
items.author: twapi
items.summary: The <usermedia> HTML element manages camera and microphone access, capturing user intent and delivering the MediaStream object. It is a declarative control for starting and interacting with media streams. This element is still in development and under discussion.

items.title: Opening up 'Zero-Knowledge Proof' technology to promote privacy in age assurance
items.author: consumer451
items.summary: Zero-Knowledge Proof technology is now open-sourced to enhance privacy in age verification, allowing developers to build privacy-focused applications without compromising personal data. This move promotes secure identity verification while prioritizing user privacy.

items.title: FFmpeg 9.1's new AAC encoder
items.author: ledoge
items.summary: FFmpeg 9.1 introduced a new AAC encoder optimized for 48kHz audio, claimed to outperform previous versions. It addresses issues with stereo PNS in the decoder. The encoder is now one of the highest-quality options in FFmpeg.

items.title: Qualcomm Linux 2.0
items.author: gilgamesh3
items.summary: Qualcomm Linux 2.0 is an upstream-first model for Dragonwing IoT, aiming to simplify development with a unified platform and maintainable customizations. It features a single system image and overlay-based architecture. The release is planned for 2026.

items.title: Healthy but sedentary people show early decline in cellular energy production
items.author: littlexsparkee
items.summary: Healthy sedentary individuals show a significant decline in muscle mitochondrial function, which may precede major diseases like cancer, diabetes, and Alzheimer's. Studies show they have reduced mitochondrial pyruvate carrier expression and lower fat oxidation during exercise. This decline in cellular energy production is a key indicator of underlying metabolic issues.

items.title: Fable 5 Is Back
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary: Fable 5 is back online after government restrictions were lifted. It was offline for over two weeks but is now available again. The U.S. Department of Commerce removed export controls on June 30, 2026.

items.title: OpenWiki: CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase
items.author: handfuloflight
items.summary: OpenWiki is a CLI tool that generates and maintains documentation for codebases, ensuring agents have up-to-date context. It initializes with a model provider and API key, then updates documentation automatically. It integrates with GitHub to keep documentation current.

items.title: Hanami 3.0: In Full Bloom
items.author: PuercoPop
items.summary: Hanami 3.0 introduces mailers, internationalization, and Minitest, enhancing app speed and developer experience. It's the most complete release with built-in features and minimal setup.

items.title: Meta caps internal AI token spending
items.author: typeofhuman
items.summary: Meta has imposed limits on internal AI token usage due to projected costs reaching billions in 2026. The company is shifting focus from extensive AI usage to more controlled spending. This move follows a trend of companies managing rising AI expenses.

items.title: Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.author: Pragmata
items.summary: The Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Anthropic's AI models, Fable 5 and Mythos 5. This decision followed negotiations and assessments of the models' risks. The export controls were officially lifted on June 30, 2026.

items.title: Newly discovered spider builds spring loaded snare to catch ants
items.author: chimpanzee
items.summary: A newly discovered Australian spider species builds a spring-loaded snare to catch only green tree ants. This specialized trap is triggered by the ants biting the web's cone. The spider is nicknamed the ballista spider.

items.title: Sony Deletes 551 Movies PlayStation Owners Paid For
items.author: bilsbie
items.summary: Sony is removing 551 movies and TV shows from PlayStation Store libraries on September 1, 2026, due to expired licensing agreements with StudioCanal, with no refunds provided. This action highlights the rental nature of digital purchases. The list includes popular titles like Terminator 2 and Hot Fuzz.

items.title: Generating Images with a 2025 Android
items.author: sudb
items.summary: By 2026, Android phones can generate AI images locally using Snapdragon 8 Gen 3's NPU, with Off Grid app. Images are processed in 5-10 seconds. No cloud or subscription needed.
